_source: CORE ELA Pacing Guide 3rd Grade - Open Up EL Education, uploaded 8/30/26, transcribed by week (parsed from the guide's M | U | L labels and lesson titles, cross-checked against Appendix A's Grade 3 ELA bullets in 2627_LP_Meeting_Plan.md).
_note: Module = EL Education Module, Unit = the Unit within that Module (unit stored as a string; lesson numbers reset per Unit, unlike OUR Math, which is why every week segments strictly on module/unit changes with no cross-unit merging - weeks 6, 13 and 16 each carry two segments for this reason). 'assessment' on a segment names any Unit Assessment / Performance Task that falls within that segment's lessons - 'Mid-Unit'/'End of Unit'/'Part I/II/III' and colon detail are all dropped, keeping only the base tag ('Unit N Assessment' or 'Performance Task'), matching Grades K/1/2's own files; a tag repeated across multiple lessons in the same segment (e.g. two 'Performance Task' lessons or the two-part 'End of Unit 3 Assessment' in week 33) is written once, not doubled. This guide runs the full 36 weeks with no early finish (unlike this grade's OUR Math file, which ends at week 35) - confirmed against Appendix A, whose LP10 bullet covers M4 U3's final three Performance Task lessons. Two guide typos, both resolved via lesson-number continuity and confirmed against Appendix A, which reproduces the same continuous lesson sequence rather than the guide's mislabel: week 8's table prints Lessons 9-10 as 'M1 | U1', though L8 (same week) was M1 U3 and L9/L10's own titles ('Drafting the Conclusion', 'End of Unit 3 Assessment, Part I: Audiobook') are plainly the continuation of Unit 3 - transcribed as M1 U3 Lessons 9-10. Week 13's table prints Lesson 2 as 'M1 | U2', though the immediately preceding lesson that same week is M2 U2 L1 and L2's title ('Close Read: "Amphibians"') continues that same Unit 2 - transcribed as M2 U2 Lesson 2. Lesson accounting is contiguous from 1 within each of the twelve Module/Unit pairs (M1: 11, 12, 14 lessons; M2: 14, 12, 12; M3: 12, 14, 13; M4: 12, 14, 13), with no gaps or duplicates, confirmed independently of the two typos above.
